blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) on Friday rejected China’s claim of sovereign rights and jurisdiction over waters off Batanes where the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) confronted a Chinese research vessel. DFA also cited a separate incident, this time near Panatag (Scarborough) Shoal, where it said China conducted a flag-raising ceremony. The […]...
